mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM erp_product WHERE deleted = 0 AND registration_expiry_date IS NOT NULL AND registration_expiry_date BETWEEN #{now} AND #{future}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM erp_supplier WHERE deleted = 0 AND license_expiry_date IS NOT NULL AND license_expiry_date < #{now}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM erp_customer WHERE deleted = 0 AND credit_limit > 0 AND (current_debt / credit_limit) >= 0.8

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) FROM erp_sale_order o INNER JOIN erp_sale_order_item i ON o.id = i.order_id AND i.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN erp_product p ON i.product_id = p.id AND p.deleted = 0 WHERE o.deleted = 0 AND p.is_restricted = 1 AND o.create_time >= #{startOfMonth}

SELECT p.id AS productId, p.name AS productName, p.standard AS standard, u.name AS unitName, s.batch_no AS batchNo, s.production_date AS productionDate, s.expiry_date AS expiryDate, s.count AS closingStock, p.is_restricted AS isRestricted FROM erp_stock s INNER JOIN erp_product p ON s.product_id = p.id AND p.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN erp_product_unit u ON u.id = p.unit_id AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE s.deleted = 0 AND s.count > 0 AND s.expiry_date IS NOT NULL AND s.expiry_date <= DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) ORDER BY s.expiry_date ASC
SELECT SUM(s.count * p.sale_price) FROM erp_stock s INNER JOIN erp_product p ON s.product_id = p.id AND p.deleted = 0 WHERE s.deleted = 0
SELECT SUM(current_debt) FROM erp_customer WHERE deleted = 0

(SELECT 1 AS type, r.no AS no, c.name AS businessName, r.total_price AS amount, a.name AS accountName, r.order_time AS time FROM erp_finance_receipt r LEFT JOIN erp_customer c ON r.customer_id = c.id LEFT JOIN erp_account a ON r.account_id = a.id WHERE r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 20 AND r.order_time BETWEEN #{beginTime} AND #{endTime}) UNION ALL (SELECT 2 AS type, p.no AS no, s.name AS businessName, p.total_price AS amount, a.name AS accountName, p.order_time AS time FROM erp_finance_payment p LEFT JOIN erp_supplier s ON p.supplier_id = s.id LEFT JOIN erp_account a ON p.account_id = a.id WHERE p.deleted = 0 AND p.status = 20 AND p.order_time BETWEEN #{beginTime} AND #{endTime}) ORDER BY time DESC
